description.value: Angus T is a Belgian-inspired artisan bakery and cafe founded in 2016 around a family croissant recipe from a small village in Belgium. Located in Vancouver's River District, it produces an extensive range of sweet and savory croissants, cinnamon buns, and babka buns daily in an open kitchen using locally and European-sourced ingredients. The cafe also serves a full espresso bar menu, making it a satisfying stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser River area.
